documents.title: Apple Bricked Smartwatches In Software Update, Suit Says
documents.content: Apple is facing a proposed class action lawsuit in California federal court, accused of intentionally rendering five generations of its smartwatches inoperable through software updates. The lawsuit alleges that this practice breaches contracts with customers by effectively "bricking" the devices before their expected useful life has ended. The legal challenge centers on Apple's alleged discontinuation of software support, leading to devices becoming unusable.

documents.title: Michigan Residents Sue Apple Over AirTag Stalking, Claim Safety Features Failed
documents.content: Two Michigan residents are suing Apple, alleging they were stalked using AirTags and that the company failed to implement adequate safety features despite knowing the potential for misuse. The lawsuit claims negligence, defective product design, invasion of privacy, and violations of the Michigan Consumer Protection Act, drawing parallels to similar ongoing federal cases against Apple. The plaintiffs argue Apple could have designed AirTags with stronger protections, such as faster alerts and louder speakers, to prevent covert tracking.

documents.title: Don't Expect Massive Upside From Apple At This Entry Point (NASDAQ:AAPL)
documents.content: Apple Inc. is rated Hold due to its mature business profile, premium valuation, and neutral technical indicators. The stock's forward PEG ratio is significantly higher than the sector median, coupled with slowing growth and margin pressures. The author suggests a base-case price target of $344, representing a 12.4% upside, which is considered insufficient for a bullish stance, recommending Microsoft and Alphabet as more attractive alternatives.

documents.title: AudioCodes Gains Microsoft Teams Voice Agent Certification
documents.content: AudioCodes has achieved Microsoft Teams Voice Agent Certification for its Voca Conversational Interaction Center (Voca CIC), expanding its presence in the AI-powered voice agent space within the Microsoft partner ecosystem. This certification allows Voca CIC's AI voice agents to handle incoming calls, authenticate callers, and route them to appropriate Teams Phone destinations, preserving caller context for human agents. The move highlights Microsoft's strategy to position Teams as a comprehensive customer interaction platform and signifies the growing importance of AI voice agents in contact center architectures, creating new opportunities for partners to provide integration and managed services.

documents.title: Microsoft retreats in China, but AI boom helps it keep a window open
documents.content: Microsoft has been steadily retreating from the Chinese market over the past five years, closing at least 15 branch offices and joint ventures, with some executives reportedly considering a full exit in 2023 due to geopolitical risks and low economic returns. China accounts for only 1.5% of Microsoft's global revenue. This strategic withdrawal is largely attributed to the erosion of trust between Washington and Beijing.

documents.title: Tesla prepares for Cybercab launch in August starting with rides to employees, the Information reports
documents.content: Tesla is reportedly preparing for the public launch of its Cybercab, an autonomous vehicle without pedals or a steering wheel, starting with a rollout in Austin, Texas, as soon as August. The company plans to begin by offering rides to employees on public roads before incorporating Cybercabs into its robotaxi service in Austin days later. This initiative is crucial for Tesla's robotaxi ambitions, with production of the Cybercab expected to ramp up later this year.

documents.title: Tesla prepares for Cybercab launch in August starting with rides to employees, the Information reports

The company plans to integrate Cybercabs into its robotaxi service shortly thereafter, having already conducted test drives, employee rides on private roads, and first responder training. Tesla did not immediately comment on the report, which also noted production of the Cybercab is expected to ramp up later this year.

documents.title: Johnson & Johnson wins FDA clearance for new robotic bronchoscopy software

The company emphasizes its commitment to advancing the platform to improve outcomes for lung cancer patients amidst increasing competition in the robotic bronchoscopy space.

AudioCodes has achieved Microsoft Teams Voice Agent Certification for its Voca Conversational Interaction Center (Voca CIC), expanding its presence in the AI-powered voice agent space within the Microsoft partner ecosystem. This certification allows Voca CIC's AI voice agents to handle incoming calls, authenticate callers, and route them to appropriate Teams Phone destinations, preserving caller context for human agents.

The move highlights Microsoft's strategy to position Teams as a comprehensive customer interaction platform and signifies the growing importance of AI voice agents in contact center architectures, creating new opportunities for partners to provide integration and managed services.
